The Statement of Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results CFR the statement of LMEL the parent or the company and its subsidiaries the parent and its subsidiaries together referred to as the Group for the Quarter and Half Year ended on 30.09.25 have been approved by the Board of Directors at the meeting held on 12.11.25.These CFR have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in Ind AS 34 Interim Financial Reporting prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act 2013 read with the relevant rules issued thereunder and the other accounting principles generally accepted in India. As per Ind AS 108 Operating Segments the Company has three reportable Operating Segments namely Mining of Iron Ore Steel and related value added products and MDO Operation and related services. The financial information for these segments have been provided in CFR as per Ind AS 108 Operating Segments. The Statutory Auditors of the Company have conducted Ltd review on the financial result for the quarter and half year ended 30.09.25. An unquallified report has been issued by them thereon. Details of Employee Stock Option for the quarter and half year ended 30.09.25 are as follows Lloyds Metals and Energy Ltd ESOP 2017 Number of options outstanding at the beginning of the period Jul1 25 5599275 Number of options exercisable at the beginning of the period July 1 2025 175502 Number of options Granted during the period 79920 Number of options Vested during the period 100795 Number of options Lapsed during the period 153482 Number of options Exercised during the period 112591 Number of options outstanding at the end of the period 30.09.25 5425393 Number of options exercisable at the end of the period 30.09.25 163231. Acquisition of MDO Business of TEMPL through Scheme of Arrangement ln accordance with the Scheme of Arrangement Scheme between the TEIL and TEMPL and their respective shareholders and creditors as approved by NCLT Division bench Court 1 Chennai by an order dtd 12.06.25 the MDO Business of TEMPL along with its related assets and liabilities at the values appearing in the books of accounts of TEMPL as on and from 12.04.25 was demerged and transferred to the TEIPL with effect from the appointed date of 1.04.25 In terms of the scheme the TEIPL has issued 215722274 9.5percentage Non Cumulative Non Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares RPS of the TEIPL of 100 each fully paid up to the shareholders of TEMPL as on record date in the ratio of 282 RPS for every 10 equity shares held in TEMPL. The effective date of the Scheme is 14.07.25. The Company has entered into the share subscription agreement dtd 17.02.25 between the Company and TEIL for the acquisition of 70 Cr equity shares representing percentage 79.82 of the total issued subscribed and paid up equity share capital of TEIL by the Company for an aggregate consideration of Rs. 70 Cr Share Subscription Agreement. Subsequent to NCLT order and pursuant to share subscription agreement TEIL has allotted shares to LMEL on dtd 01.07.25. On 19.07.25 LSPL has allotted 566037736 equity shares of face value 1 each at an issue price of 1.06 per share comprising 1 face value and 0.06 as share premium aggregating to a total consideration of Rs. 60 Cr only. The shares were allotted to Thriveni Earthmovers and Infra Pvt Ltd on a preferential basis through Pvt placement. As a result of this transaction Lloyds Surya Pvt Ltd has ceased to be a subsidiary of the Company and become step down subsidiary. Earning Per Share are not annualised except for year ended 31.03.25. Revenue shown in segmental information includes other income. The figures for the corresponding previous period have been regrouped reclassified wherever necessary to make them comparable.
The results for the quarter and half year ended 30 Sep25 are available on the website of BSE at www.bseindia.com NSE at www.nseindia.com and on Company's website at www.lloyds.in
